Swatch Board third-party notice collection
==========================================

This collection records license and notice files found in the checksum-verified
Cargo.lock registry archives, plus identified upstream files at their recorded
source commits. It conservatively includes build, test and other-platform
dependencies; inclusion does not establish that a package is in a binary.
License expressions below are upstream declarations, not legal conclusions.
Files marked unavailable still require review before public distribution.
See docs/release.md for scope, limitations and update instructions.
